name: CURVES HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.
summary: CURVES HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation, management, and franchising of fitness clubs in Japan and internationally. The company operates clubs under the 30-minute Women-only Wellness Fitness Club Curves and 30-minute No-Reservation Assisted Gym Men's Curves brands. It also operates a membership-based exercise facility for people suffering from lower back, knees, and shoulder problems under the Physical Movement Recovery Center Pint-UP brand; and an online fitness service under the Curves at Home brand. In addition, the company distributes protein products. CURVES HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
